span.label: existence
span.quote: A stream of perceptual, semantic and motor processes can therefore occur without awareness.

span.label: masked semantic priming of number comparison
span.quote: Visual words that are masked and presented so briefly that they cannot be seen may nevertheless facilitate the subsequent processing of related words, a phenomenon called masked priming1,2.

span.label: fmri
span.quote: Here we use a combination of behavioural and brain-imaging techniques to estimate the depth of processing of masked numerical primes.

span.label: ERP localisation of the covert priming effect is spatially imprecise, which is why fMRI was added
span.quote: Because ERPs have a notoriously imprecise spatial resolution, we wanted to confirm that covert priming originated at least in part from motor circuits using the spatially accurate method of functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI).

span.label: The haemodynamic measure is too coarse to resolve the small activation delays produced by masked priming
span.quote: Although this coarse haemodynamic measure cannot resolve the small activation delays associated with masked priming, we reasoned that it should be proportional to the total brain activity accumulated during a given trial, and should therefore reflect the sum of overt and covert activation in motor areas.

This indicates that the prime was unconsciously processed according to task instructions, all the way down to the motor system

span.label: THE INVISIBLE PRIME APPLIES THE TASK INSTRUCTIONS, WHICH IS A STRONGER CLAIM THAN SEMANTIC ACTIVATION. `The interference between prime and target can be attributed to a COVERT, PRIME-INDUCED ACTIVATION OF MOTOR CORTEX, a response bias that must be overcome in incongruent trials. This indicates that the prime was UNCONSCIOUSLY PROCESSED ACCORDING TO TASK INSTRUCTIONS, ALL THE WAY DOWN TO THE MOTOR SYSTEM.` **The unseen numeral was compared to 5 and a hand was prepared.** Most masked-priming records in this corpus argue about whether MEANING was reached; this one argues that a RULE was executed on something nobody saw
span.quote: We then showed that the interference between prime and target can be attributed to a covert, prime-induced activation of motor cortex, a response bias that must be overcome in incongruent trials. This indicates that the prime was unconsciously processed according to task instructions, all the way down to the motor system

span.label: AND THE CONTROL ANSWERS THE OBJECTION THAT WEAKENED AN EARLIER RESULT IN THIS SAME CORPUS: `the ENTIRE RESPONSE TIME DISTRIBUTION was shifted by ~24 ms in incongruent trials compared with congruent trials. Thus, THERE WAS NO EVIDENCE THAT THE EFFECT WAS FOUND IN ONLY A SMALL PROPORTION OF SUBJECTS OR A SMALL NUMBER OF TRIALS with a distinct distribution of response times.` buchner2003 - tagged three records ago - reports that Driver & Baylis's cross-modal effect `was observed only for a small subgroup of 14 (out of 24) participants`, which `leaves some uncertainty as to the reality` of it. **This paper pre-empts exactly that, with a distributional argument rather than an average**, and reports that all 12 subjects showed the effect
span.quote: Furthermore, the entire response time distribution was shifted by ,24 ms in incongruent trials compared with congruent trials. Thus, there was no evidence that the effect was found in only a small proportion of subjects or a small number of trials with a distinct distribution of response times

span.label: THE WHOLE PROCESSING CHAIN IS PLACED OUTSIDE AWARENESS IN ONE SENTENCE: `A stream of PERCEPTUAL, SEMANTIC AND MOTOR processes can therefore occur WITHOUT AWARENESS.` Three stages, named in order, and the claim is that none of them requires consciousness. **That is the sentence the rest of this corpus's masked-priming records are arguing with** - Holcomb2005 asks whether the N400 stage is automatic, Huang2018 restricts affective primacy to face stimuli, Kouider2008 asks about levels of processing. Here all three levels are claimed at once, from a single 43 ms numeral
span.quote: A stream of perceptual, semantic and motor processes can therefore occur without awareness

span.note: about this quote: THE MATHS LAYER OF THE STAGED TEXT WAS MOJIBAKE AND HAS BEEN REPAIRED. This paper's extraction rendered `=` as U+00BC (the vulgar fraction one quarter) and `+` as U+00FE (thorn), so the quote read `p ¼ 0.01` where the paper says `p = 0.01`. It passed every check we own, because the staged text said the same wrong thing: the offsets were right and text_sha1 matched. Repaired only where the character stands in an operator's place - spaced, with a number after it - because the same U+00BC is a REAL QUARTER in six other papers ('a ¼ inch condenser microphone'). Original in `evidence_as_extracted`, pre-repair file in DATA/_restage_backups/. Found by CLAUDE_B. See Q-719. || QUOTE RECOVERED FROM THE PAPER'S OWN CHARACTERS (Q-701). The recorded quote was LETTERS-ONLY IDENTICAL to this stretch of the staged text but not an exact substring of it - spaces, hyphens, ligature glyphs or mathematical operators differed, so it could never anchor. This is the file's own text between the same two letters: not produced by a rule about the damage, copied out of the file. Round-trip checked (the recovered span is letters-only equal to the original) and length-checked. The text as originally recorded is kept in `evidence_as_extracted`.
